anchor_commit.description: Git HEAD recorded automatically when the DAG is created. This is a provenance/drift marker only, not an execution base, repository snapshot, cleanliness requirement, or commit-matching guard. Discovery, reads, preview, compilation, and execution use the live repository state.

root.description: Node id of the root semantic node. The root is always a decomposition-only semantic node: it directly requires at least one semantic child and never directly requires terminal work. The service sets decomposition_only=true on the root at creation; callers never supply it.

requires.description: 'requires' is the DAG's only edge and expresses what must become true for a semantic requirement to be fulfilled. It is ALL-of: when present, every referenced node must be satisfied. Omission denotes an unresolved semantic node. References may converge on shared descendants but must never create a path back to an ancestor. A semantic node may directly require at most one 'run' node; when it directly requires a 'run', every other required node must be type 'semantic'.

decomposition_only.description: Persisted authoring intent, not runtime state. When true, this semantic requirement intentionally owns no direct terminal work: its obligation is fully decomposed into the semantic requirements it directly 'requires'. It may only be set true on a semantic node that directly requires at least one child, and every direct child must be semantic. Runtime satisfaction still derives only from the satisfaction of 'requires' children; this field never affects execution. Absent or false preserves all existing child structures and run-barrier rules. Only a bounded worker that has investigated the requirement may set it, through dag_set_decomposition_only. The root node is always true and is set automatically by dag_create; the root is immutable and can never be changed through dag_set_decomposition_only.

overwrite.description: When true, atomically replace an existing destination with the moved source (native replace). When false (default), the destination must not already exist and a collision is an ordinary recoverable terminal failure.

command.description: Execution command as an argv array, executed with shell=False. It is not a shell string. One canonical policy module checks it against an exact executable-plus-subcommand allowlist.

exclusive.description: When true, execute this run node without any other run node executing concurrently within the active DAG.

oneOf.description: Terminal command node and satisfaction barrier for implementation/verification work. Its semantic parent may have semantic siblings for it, but no other terminal siblings. Publication lifecycle commands such as commit, push, PR creation, release, or deployment belong outside the Change DAG; a local executor-generated checkpoint commit on successful DAG completion is separate executor lifecycle behavior, not a run node. exclusive defaults to false. command is an argv array executed with shell=False through one canonical policy allowlist.

$comment: The Change DAG validator enforces invariants beyond JSON shape: requires is the only ALL-of graph edge; the root is always a decomposition-only semantic node that requires only semantic children; reachability, acyclicity, shared-descendant identity, derived depth, and run-child constraints are validated; anchor_commit is provenance only; unresolved semantic nodes are valid but unsatisfied.
